 sum(CASE WHEN sale_date <> CAST(sale_ts_utc AS DATE) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) date_ne_utc,

SELECT o.status, o.fulfilment_type, o.login_state, count(*) orders, sum(l.g) lines_gross, sum(o.order_total_gross) order_gross, sum(CASE WHEN l.n<>o.line_count THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) cnt_mismatch, sum(CASE WHEN abs(l.g-o.order_total_gross)>0.02 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) amt_mismatch

SELECT date_trunc('month', sale_date) m, p.vat_class, f.vat_rate, count(*) n, sum(gross_amount) g
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
WHERE channel_code='WB' AND sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-07-29' AND DATE '2024-10-27'
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2,3

SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, sum(f.gross_amount) web_gross_incl_vat, sum(f.net_amount) net, count(*) n
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
WHERE f.channel_code='WB' AND d.fiscal_year='FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 4 AND 6
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 2
